title: One calculation, four forms
description: You can compare where four versions put the work of selecting, squaring, and adding even numbers.

steps.description: The imperative loop keeps a running total. Each even n contributes its square.
EvenSquareSummer puts the running total inside an object. offer updates that field when n is even.
Read the functional expression from the inside out: filter selects, map squares, and reduce adds.

steps.question: Will the comprehension calculate a different number from the loop?
steps.answer: Both calculate 120 from the squares of 2, 4, 6, and 8.

steps.description: The comprehension names the source, selection, and transformation in one expression. The displayed results give 120 for all four forms.
